description: In the Wazuh dashboard, navigate to the Configuration Assessment module. You start on the Dashboard tab showing the CIS Benchmark compliance score for the Wazuh manager (agent 000). Click the 'Checks' tab to view the full list of individual security checks. Use the filter to show only FAILED checks: click on the result filter dropdown and select 'failed'. The filtered list will show all checks that are not compliant. Click on the first failed check in the list and read its 'Rationale' and 'Remediation' fields. The task is complete when the filter shows 'failed' checks only and a check's Remediation guidance text is visible on screen.
